description: Workflow v3.1 Enterprise. LLM-adapted Scrum sprint: PLANNING→ACTIVE→REVIEW→RETRO→CLOSE. TaskRegistry actions as the sole LLM interface (no direct CPG/CKG/delta-spring exposure). REFINE with context, loop detection, and knowledge capture.

context_bag.description: Catalog of placeholders the engine resolves in prompt templates (prompts/{prompt_id}.prompt.json) before presenting to the agent. Each placeholder is replaced with its current value from sprint state or context_bag on step(). Si nadie provee un placeholder, el renderer lo deja VACÍO (no literal); hay un BDD que falla si una plantilla usa una clave que nadie provee.

project_id.description: Active project ID detected or provided by the user

sprint_goal.description: Active sprint goal, defined during planning

task_count.description: Total number of tasks in the active sprint backlog

completed_count.description: Number of completed tasks in the active sprint

goal_display.source: Engine formats sprint_goal for dashboard: 'Goal: <sprint_goal>' or 'Goal: Not set'
goal_display.description: Formatted sprint goal line for dashboard display

ready_tasks.source: Engine deriva ready_tasks desde el DeltaGraph (spring specs depends_on)
ready_tasks.description: List of tasks whose dependencies are all met and are ready to work on

blocked_tasks.source: Engine deriva blocked_tasks desde el DeltaGraph (spring specs depends_on)
blocked_tasks.description: List of tasks blocked by incomplete dependencies

task_summary.source: Engine formats task summary for review: brief list of completed/pending
task_summary.description: Formatted task status summary for sprint review

source_node.source: ReflectionProvider (feature event_tracing) — derivado del TraceGraph (TRANSITION to REFINE)
source_node.description: Node that triggered refine. Provided via REFLECTION context layer (NOT engine-injected).

attempt.source: ReflectionProvider — contado desde TRANSITION to REFINE en el TraceGraph
attempt.description: Current refine attempt number (1, 2, 3). Provided via REFLECTION context layer.

error_context.description: Failure context. Provided via REFLECTION context layer.

task_id.source: Engine inyecta desde el DeltaGraph (spring context) al hacer transicion a ANALYZE, IMPLEMENT o REFINE
task_id.description: Active task ID (TASK-XXX). Used by agent to fetch briefing via context tasks.

predicates.source: Engine lee task validation.predicates desde el DeltaGraph (spring spec)
predicates.description: List of validation predicates for the current task (DoD criteria)

context_schema.description: SSOT del contexto de entrada (F2 SPEC-043 / ADR-043 §9.2-A): forma de cada capa que el agente recibe. Fuente: features/engine/context/contracts.py (CONTEXT_SCHEMAS); el engine deriva los schemas en ComposedContext.context_schemas. 9 providers: business, ckg, cpg, delta, diff, project, reflection, test_results, trace.
